answers.how: The plane moves approximately 290 px/s and measures about 184 px nose to tail. Its length is 184 × 22.16 / 290 ≈ 14.1 m.
The wingtip-to-wingtip extent is approximately 239 px. Using the motion-derived scale, its width is 239 × 22.16 / 290 ≈ 18.3 m.
The plane moves in a straight line at constant speed, so its displacement is 22.16 × (1.0 − 0.5) = 11.08 m.
